arStrings.szText: The Diablo IV BlizzCon Bundle includes three in-game items: the Streamsnout pet, the Indigo cat mount, and Escapeproof mount armor. Conquer your enemies with your Streamsnout otter companion by your side as you traverse Sanctuary atop your mystical Indigo Cat, protected by its Escapeproof armor.
Adorn your steed in Diablo IV with the Indigo's Light Trophy and Indigo's Master Trophy, mount trophies that mark your victories across Sanctuary with a sign of mastery earned in battle.
